findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation, before you are guaranteed full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment of all Fees due under this Agreement, Developer hereby assigns and transfers to Client all copyright and other intellectual property ownership in the Works.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a minor update before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the text currently transfers intellectual property ownership before payment is guaranteed, so I propose updating it so that ownership transfers upon receipt of full payment of all fees due. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
